params.prompt: Production game-world asset sheet for POLITICMON, satirical Italian monster RPG. Same handcrafted chunky 16-bit pixel-art style, limited midnight navy, warm cream, mint green, antique gold and muted burgundy palette, strong clean pixel clusters, no photographic or painted gradients. Exactly 4 equal rectangular cells in a STRICT 2 COLUMN by 2 ROW grid, no labels or separators. TOP LEFT: a single wide row of seven audience members seen from behind, heads and shoulders only, standing still with arms down, navy and cream silhouettes with small burgundy and mint details; TOP RIGHT: the same row of seven audience members clapping with raised hands; BOTTOM LEFT: the same row of seven audience members booing, hands cupped at their mouths; BOTTOM RIGHT: the same row of seven audience members holding up smartphones with glowing screens. Each cell contains one wide, low row of figures centered with ample pure WHITE margin on the left, right and top, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no background scene. Flat side-on pixel art, no 3/4 view. No text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, watermark or game interface.
